title: Clickable shell + fail-open bootstrap
summary: YTIntel no longer hides the whole app behind a blocking boot state. The shell is visible immediately, navigation is wired at the entry layer, and every downstream module import is isolated so one failed optional module cannot make the entire site blank or unclickable.
discord_changes: 🖱️ CLICK LOCK FIXED: the YTIntel shell now renders visible and clickable immediately instead of waiting behind a full-screen boot overlay.
🛡️ FAIL-OPEN BOOTSTRAP: every feature module now loads inside its own guarded import, so one bad module cannot brick the entire app.
↔️ NAV FALLBACK: Analyse / Watchtower / Vault routing now has an entry-level click handler that still works even if a downstream UI module fails.
↩️ RETURN SAFE: the previous YouTube/back-navigation recovery remains active, with YouTube links hardened into a separate tab.
changes: Removed the blocking boot overlay from index.html.
Removed initial hidden and v360-prehide state from the app shell.
Moved release ownership to the top of v360-entry.js before feature modules hydrate.
Changed sequential top-level awaits into guarded imports that collect failures instead of aborting the whole entry script.
Added entry-level navigation routing so core tabs remain clickable regardless of optional module failures.
Prevented an unhydrated Analyse form from replacing/reloading the app document.
Reveals and repairs the shell both before and after module hydration.
Bumped service-worker, manifest and browser cache keys to v0.37.9 so stale black-screen code is replaced.
known_limitations: The Discord message contains the literal text @aaron. A guaranteed Discord push mention requires Aaron's numeric Discord user ID formatted as <@USER_ID>, which is not stored in the repository.
If the browser itself or an extension crashes the renderer process, the web app cannot recover until the page process restarts.
Individual advanced modules may still fail independently, but v0.37.9 is specifically designed to keep the core shell visible and clickable when that happens.
why_it_matters: A research app must never become unusable because one optional feature fails. v0.37.9 changes the failure mode from 'entire site is dead' to 'the shell stays usable while the failed feature is isolated'.
